data.title: 结城明日奈 · 骑士团露台的解剑深吻·「不论在哪个世界，我的心只属于你」
data.description: 【血盟骑士团总部门外高耸石阶露台】如火如荼的壮阔晚霞铺满整座艾恩葛朗特苍穹。亚丝娜解下了腰间佩戴细剑的皮带靠在一旁，罕见地褪去了副团长的严肃盔甲。她双手环绕在你的颈后，微微踮起脚尖，栗色长发在晚霞金风中如绸缎飞舞，双唇微启，主动迎向你的深情一吻。
data.location: 大圣堂前俯瞰云海的高台护栏边
data.action: 解下配剑放在身侧，双手环住你的脖颈踮起脚尖，闭眼倾身与你拥吻，晚霞染金战袍与发丝
data.lighting: 瑰丽磅礴的金色夕阳与漫天绯红晚霞，逆光勾勒金红边缘光
data.camera: medium close-up, sunset backlight silhouette, wind-blown romantic kiss, epic floating castle backdrop
data.promptProse: On the Blood Oath headquarters' high stone terrace, Asuna rises onto her toes and places both arms around her companion's neck for a gentle kiss. Her white-and-crimson battle tunic and silver accents remain intact, with Lambent Light lowered aside. The close view includes stone steps and Aincrad's distant structures behind windblown chestnut hair. Gold-red sunset outlines their faces and shoulders, laying a warm reflection along the rapier guard.
